written.headline: Newspapers sue Brave over search index sales to AI companies
written.summary: The New York Times and other newspaper publishers filed federal lawsuits against Brave Software, alleging the company illegally scraped over 30 billion web pages and sold access to them to AI firms. The lawsuits also accuse Brave of bypassing paywalls and copyright infringement.

written.headline: Meta brings Active Memory and Active Focus to Muse and Meta AI
written.summary: Meta has trained specialized versions of its existing models using its Muse Wonder frontier model to bring Active Memory and Active Focus to all Muse and Meta AI users. The company reports a 67% improvement for Muse in finishing everyday tasks that encounter unexpected obstacles.
